Seerist is hiring a Software Engineer 1 to build and maintain data ingestion and processing infrastructure for its Collections & Alerts platform. The role focuses on high-volume data pipelines, event-driven systems, production observability, and collaboration with intelligence analysts and product teams.

Responsibilities
You will join the Collections & Alerts software development team to build the platform's data ingestion and processing infrastructure
You'll design and build high-volume data pipelines, architect event-driven systems that process intelligence data at scale, optimize queries and schemas for heavy load, instrument services for observability, and debug production issues across distributed systems
You'll work directly with our intelligence analysts and product team to understand requirements and ensure software meets both performance and analytical needs

Required
Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and other modern languages
Experience designing and debugging event-driven systems (EventBridge, message queues, async patterns, orchestration)
Experience building high-volume, low-latency data ingestion and processing pipelines; understanding of batch vs. real-time tradeoffs
Hands-on work with SQS, S3, ECR, AWS CDK; comfortable reasoning about cloud infrastructure costs and scaling
Working knowledge of both relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB); experience optimizing queries and schema design for high-volume workloads
Experience with in-memory data stores (Redis), familiarity with OpenSearch/ElasticSearch (full-text search, indexing strategies)
Proficiency with Datadog or similar monitoring tools; ability to instrument code for observability and debug production issues
Understanding of service boundaries, async communication patterns, and debugging across distributed systems
Comfortable with AWS CDK or similar tools for defining infrastructure in code
Comfortable leveraging AI tooling for development acceleration, building custom skills, and automating repetitive tasks
